title.narrative: UN Partnership on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Fund

description.narrative: The Fund supports the United Nations Partnership on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (UNPRPD), a unique collaborative effort that brings together UN entities, governments, disabled people’s organizations and the broader civil society to advance disability rights around the world.
